10: A strong frame shows a curved row of cleanly lit dominoes on a table, mid-collapse, with a clear wave front of tilted tiles. Score 1-5 each: (1) Composition and camera: entire path visible, readable angle, good scale. (2) Lighting and shadows: soft directional shadows grounding every tile, no flat unlit look. (3) Materials and color: table, tiles and ball clearly distinguishable, tiles have tasteful variation or pips, not default grey. (4) Physical plausibility: tiles tilt, rotate and rest at believable angles with no interpenetration, jitter or floating. (5) UI polish: Release/Reset buttons legible, unobtrusive, no overlap with the scene focal area.
11: A strong frame shows a crane with a heavy chained ball impacting or just after impacting a wooden crate pyramid, crates flying apart. Score 1-5 each: (1) Composition: crane, ball path and pyramid all in frame with dynamic angle. (2) Lighting and shadows: directional light, contact shadows under crates and ball, depth cues. (3) Materials: wood-grained or clearly wood-coloured crates, metallic ball and crane, concrete ground, not uniform flat colour. (4) Motion and physics believability: crates tumble, rotate and settle naturally; chain length consistent; no explosion or tunnelling. (5) Scene dressing and UI: sky/background, crane detail, legible buttons that do not cover the action.
12: A strong frame shows a glossy pegboard with balls caught mid-fall and a handful already resting in numbered bins with counts. Score 1-5 each: (1) Composition and camera: full board centred, upright orientation, readable scale. (2) Lighting and depth: key and rim light, specular highlights on balls and pegs, shadows or ambient occlusion giving depth. (3) Materials and color: distinct palette for balls, pegs, bins and backboard, visually cohesive and not default grey. (4) Physical plausibility and readability: bounces look natural, no balls stuck or passing through pegs, counts align with visible balls. (5) UI polish: buttons and bin counters legible, well aligned with bins, no clutter over the board.
